title: A little about me!
text:
I’m a University of Sydney Master of Management graduate with a Distinction average, alongside degrees in Law and Biological Science from the University of Auckland. I’m currently based in Sydney and am open to relocating to Melbourne or London.
My background combines commercial and quantitative analysis with professional experience in legal research, stakeholder management and project delivery.
During my Master’s, I led a live consulting engagement for an Australian business, conducting customer research and competitor analysis to develop commercial growth recommendations presented to senior executives.
I also have experience using R, Excel and statistical modelling to analyse complex datasets and communicate findings to non-technical audiences.

This portfolio documents independent research projects where I apply quantitative analysis and commercial reasoning to real-world business questions.
Each project aims to move beyond describing data to evaluating commercial implications and developing practical recommendations.

Featured Research


The Price of Access

Evaluating the Australian Grand Prix’s New Ticketing Strategy
Commercial Strategy | Pricing | Revenue Modelling
An independent assessment of the Australian Grand Prix’s revised ticketing and membership strategy, exploring its implications for revenue, customer demand and long-term fan loyalty.
Using Excel financial modelling and R-based analysis, this project will evaluate the commercial trade-offs associated with the new model.
Status: Research in progress
